_comment: People shown under the old 1.5x people bar (before 2026-10-26) who do not yet meet the 1.125x bar. They keep the old bar for one more audit pass: the id is removed once the audit meets the new bar, or once it has two passes (`passes` in the audit) and still does not, and the person then leaves the site. test.js enforces both. Nobody is added.
